question:
In the following figure, the square represents "lemon", the circle represents "sweet", the triangle represents "fruits", the rectangle represents "sour", and the hexagon represents "oranges".

Find the number which represents lemon fruits that are sour but NOT sweet.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/19b713170714ad35bdcffb7c2d531e27b4d6a9efb8736daef9c8148636c869f5.png]
solution:
Refer to the diagram as shown below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e2f4a959c2193847057ef9d2fbdf2bda7f8adc4c9697aa3c6568f7eeb471e842.png] 

Here, the shaded area represents lemon fruits that are sour but NOT sweet.

Hence, 'option(1) - 45' is the correct answer.
